title: Geometric Structures of Pseudo-Sonic Curves in Self-Similar Solutions of the Euler Equations for Potential Flow
summary: We are concerned with the geometric structures of pseudo-sonic curves in two-dimensional self-similar solutions for the Euler equations for potential flow, allowing for non-uniform supersonic states. Mathematically, the governing second-order potential flow equation is of mixed hyperbolic-elliptic type, with degeneracy occurring along the pseudo-sonic curve. In this paper, we develop rigorous analytical approaches to analyze the geometric structures of pseudo-sonic curves in such self-similar solutions.
